name: seis-secret-boundary-scan
description: Read-only scoped scan for likely secrets and private-path leakage in text files.

interface.shortDescription: Flag likely secret material without printing values.
interface.longDescription: A bounded local SEIS security plugin that scans selected text files for high-signal secret patterns and private-path leakage, returning redacted findings only and never sending, writing, or exposing matched values.
defaultPrompt: Scan this scope for secret-boundary risks.
Find likely credentials without printing values.
